content:
sophie: quick brain-dump: propose a tiny "inspect samples" surface per-route in Console that shows sampling rates, redaction-band, and whether pre/post scrub diffs are available. keep defaults conservative so PII exposure doesn't increase.

matt: are we doing separate debug vs archive streams or one stream with tags?

sophie: one stream with tags: INSPECT (Console ephemeral, 24h TTL, breakglass) and ARCHIVE (secure store, strict RBAC).

rahul: defaults suggestion: text-only routes get INSPECT=0.01%, ARCHIVE=0.001%. any route accepting files, embeddings, or payment webhooks = auto-opt-out until tenant opts in with justification.
tanya: display: prefer banded redaction confidence (LOW/MED/HIGH) + short reason tag ("email", "ssn-like", "ocr-attachment"). avoid raw floats to prevent over-reliance.

ops-bot: policy-scan: route /v1/upload -> sensitivity=0.94 -> auto-opt-out applied.

sophie: good. breakglass must require justification and be stored (actor + reason). INSPECT views expire after 24h; ARCHIVE follows tenant retention.
matt: infra notes: add global kill-switch that sets all INSPECT rates to 0 immediately and an org-level monthly sample cap. show a Console banner when kill-switch active.

rahul: also enforce dedupe so retries don't multiply samples (dedupe window 5m by request fingerprint). add counters so billing and alerts are obvious.
tanya: UI: show inline "inspect: 0.01% / archive: 0.001%" with a tiny cost preview button that computes projected samples/month = recent_30d_requests * rate and token cost delta before commit.

sophie: security corner: do not surface raw pre-scrub payloads for MED band by default. only show diffs or full pre-scrub body when tenant opted into diffs or band=HIGH and with legal approval.

matt: quick config sketch for infra/product sync:
```yaml
route: /v1/chat/complete
sampling:
  inspect_rate: 1e-4   # 0.01% inspect Console-visible
  archive_rate: 1e-5   # 0.001% archive
redaction:
  display: banded      # LOW|MED|HIGH
  reason_tags: true
  attachments: auto_opt_out
dedupe_ttl_seconds: 300
```
rahul: telemetry to emit: inspect_emitted_total, inspect_views_total, archive_emitted_total, redaction_band_counts{route,band}. also a weekly regression job that feeds archived samples into Optimize evals and alerts on scrub regressions.
tanya: compliance: add an opt-in template for attachments/embeddings that records legal justification, product review, and RBAC lists. store opt-ins as audit events.

sophie: next steps: I'll write a short RFC and a tiny Console mock. owner: @matt for infra (kill-switch, dedupe, caps) and @tanya for compliance wording. will drop RFC link here when ready. :eyes:
